<!--
Purpose: build the property-level modeling table used by Yes_ACesimtation_HPC.py
and Alltype_ACesimtation_HPC_predict.py.

Working directory: an .Rmd file uses the folder it lives in as the working
directory, so all input/output files below are given as paths relative to
this file. Put the input files next to this .Rmd (or edit the relative paths).

Inputs (see "Data sources" in README.md for links):
  1. Dewey_selected_data.csv            - Dewey property records (proprietary), one row per property
  2. Dewey_imputed.csv                  - imputed Dewey attributes, output of Dewey_imputation.Rmd
  3. tl_2020_us_cbsa.shp                - Census TIGER/Line 2020 Core Based Statistical Area (metro/micro) shapefile
  4. US_tract_2020.shp                  - 2020 census tract shapefile (NHGIS / Census TIGER/Line)
  5. Combined_CoolingDegreedDays.csv   - county cooling degree days, 1970-2024 (NOAA Climate at a Glance)
  6. census2020_tract.csv               - tract-level ACS 5-year socio-demographic variables
  7. BUPR_tract.csv                     - tract-level built-up property records (HISDAC-US BUPR)
  8. HRS2020_tract.csv                  - tract-level Historic Redlining Score (2020 tracts)
Final output:
  allcombined_for_contemporal_prediction.csv - input for Yes_ACesimtation_HPC.py
-->

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidycensus)
library(data.table)
library(sf)
```


# combine dewey data
```{r}
# Raw Dewey property records (CSV). Must include LAT, LON, FIPS, PROPID,
# AIRCONDITIONINGCODE, CNSSTRACT, ZIPCODE, COUNTY and STATE.
df<- fread("./Dewey_selected_data.csv")
acdf <- df%>%dplyr::select(c("LAT","LON","FIPS","PROPID","AIRCONDITIONINGCODE","CNSSTRACT","ZIPCODE","COUNTY", "STATE"))

acdf<- acdf %>%
  mutate(AIRCONDITIONINGrecode = case_when(
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 1 ~ "Central",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 2 ~ "Evaporative Cooler",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 3 ~ "None",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 4 ~ "Central",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 5 ~ "Others",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 6 ~ "None",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 7 ~ "Others",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 8 ~ "Others",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 9 ~ "Others",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 10 ~ "None",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE== 11 ~ "None",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 12 ~ "Others",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 13 ~ "Yes",
    AIRCONDITIONINGCODE == 14 ~ "Central",
    TRUE ~ as.character(AIRCONDITIONINGCODE) # for any other unexpected values
  ))
rm(df)
# Imputed Dewey attributes (CSV) produced by Dewey_imputation.Rmd
# (category and numeric imputed values joined by PROPID).
imputedf <- read.csv("./Dewey_imputed.csv")

#merge with acdf
DF <- merge(acdf, imputedf, all.y=TRUE, by =c("PROPID"))
residf <-DF%>%filter(Classification == "Residential-Owned")
# Save residential owner-occupied properties; read back further below.
write.csv(residf, "./Dewey_residential_owned.csv", row.names=F)
```

#boundary
```{r}
# Core Based Statistical Area boundaries (shapefile, .shp), e.g. Census TIGER/Line tl_2020_us_cbsa.
# Keep the .shp together with its .shx/.dbf/.prj files.
metro<- st_read("./boundary/tl_2020_us_cbsa/tl_2020_us_cbsa.shp")
metro <- metro %>%
  dplyr::rename(CBSA_GEOID = GEOID)%>%select(CBSA_GEOID,NAME,LSAD)

# 2020 census tract boundaries (shapefile, .shp) with a GEOID column (NHGIS or Census TIGER/Line).
tract <- st_read("./boundary/US_tract_2020/US_tract_2020.shp")%>%select(GEOID)

joined_data <- st_join(tract , metro, join = st_intersects)
censusmetro<-joined_data %>%
  mutate(Metorlevel = ifelse(is.na(LSAD), "NotMetro", LSAD))  %>% as.data.frame()%>%select(-c("geometry","LSAD","NAME"))%>%
  distinct(GEOID, .keep_all = TRUE)# Remove geometry column

head(censusmetro)
```

```{r}
vars <- load_variables(2021, "acs5", cache = TRUE)
boundary <- get_acs(
        geography = "county",
        variables = 'B01001A_001',
        year = 2020,
        output = "wide",
      )%>%dplyr::select(-c("B01001A_001E","B01001A_001M")) %>% #
  separate(NAME, into = c("Name", "State"), sep = ", ")%>%as.data.frame()%>%filter(State != "Puerto Rico" & State != "Alaska" & State != "Hawaii")

```

# combine all the data for contemporal time periods
```{r}
# County-level annual cooling degree days (CSV), 1970-2024, downloaded from NOAA NCEI
# Climate at a Glance (county time series, "Cooling Degree Days") and combined into one file.
# Columns: ID (state abbreviation + county FIPS, e.g. "AL-001"), Name, State, Value (CDDs), year, ...
# GEOIDCN (5-digit county FIPS) is built from ID: state abbreviation -> state FIPS
# using tidycensus::fips_codes, followed by the 3-digit county code.
cdddf <- read.csv( "./Combined_CoolingDegreedDays.csv")%>%
  dplyr::rename(YEAR = year)%>%
  mutate(state_abbr = substr(ID, 1, 2), county_code = substr(ID, 4, 6))%>%
  left_join(distinct(fips_codes, state, state_code), by = c("state_abbr" = "state"))%>%
  mutate(GEOIDCN = paste0(state_code, county_code))%>%
  filter(YEAR == 2024)%>%
  mutate(GEOIDCN = ifelse(Name == "District of Columbia", '11001', GEOIDCN))%>%dplyr::select(c("Value","YEAR", "GEOIDCN"))
cdddf$GEOIDCN<-  sprintf("%05s", cdddf$GEOIDCN)
# Tract-level ACS 5-year socio-demographic variables (CSV) with GEOID, CountyName, State,
# median_income, prop_Black, prop_All_Spanish, prop_HigherEdu, ...
census2020 <- read.csv("./census2020_tract.csv")#%>%filter(year == 2021)

#combine the CDD and census
DF <- merge(boundary, cdddf, by.x = 'GEOID', by.y ='GEOIDCN', all.x=TRUE )%>% dplyr::rename(GEOIDCN=GEOID )
DFall <- merge(census2020, DF, by.x = c("CountyName","State"), by.y = c("Name",   "State"), all.x =TRUE)%>%filter(State != "Puerto Rico" & State != "Alaska" & State != "Hawaii")
DFall$GEOID<- sprintf("%011s", DFall$GEOID)

#combine with BUPR
# Tract-level built-up property records (CSV) from HISDAC-US, with STATE, COUNTY, GEOID, BUPR.
BUPR <- read.csv("./BUPR_tract.csv")
BUPR$STATE<- sprintf("%02d", BUPR$STATE)
BUPR$COUNTY <- sprintf("%03d", BUPR$COUNTY)
BUPR$GEOID<- as.character(BUPR$GEOID)
BUPR$GEOID<- sprintf("%011s", BUPR$GEOID)

result <- merge( DFall,BUPR, by = c("GEOID"), all.x =TRUE)

#combine with redlining
# Tract-level Historic Redlining Score for 2020 tracts (CSV) with GEOID20, HRI2020.
red<- read.csv("./HRS2020_tract.csv")%>% dplyr::rename(GEOID=GEOID20 )
red$GEOID<- sprintf("%011s", red$GEOID)

Red <- merge(result, red, by = c("GEOID"), all.x =TRUE)%>%dplyr::select(-c("INTERVAL2020", "METRO_NAME", "YEAR","Year", "geometry"))%>% dplyr::rename(CDDs=Value )%>%filter(State != "Puerto Rico" & State != "Alaska" & State != "Hawaii")
Red <- left_join(Red, censusmetro)
#
#write.csv(Red,"./tract_covariates.csv",row.names = FALSE)
#combine with resident
library(readr)
# Tract-level covariate table (CSV) saved above, joined with residential housing-unit counts.
Red <- read_csv("./tract_covariates.csv")%>%select(-c("Tract","State","CountyName", "Black", "Hispanic","total_population", "total_house","year", "Poverty","RenterOccupied", "HigherEdu","STATE","COUNTY", "CBSA10","STATEFP","COUNTYFP","TRACTCE","GISJOIN" ,"CBSA_GEOID"))
Red$GEOIDCN<- sprintf("%05s",as.character(Red$GEOIDCN))
Red$GEOID<- sprintf("%011s",as.character(Red$GEOID))



# Residential owner-occupied Dewey properties written in the first chunk.
residf <- read.csv("./Dewey_residential_owned.csv")
residf$AIRCONDITIONINGrecode<- recode(residf$AIRCONDITIONINGrecode,"None"="NoAC")
residf$REHEATTYPE<- recode(residf$REHEATTYPE,"None"="Noheater")

residf$GEOIDCN<- sprintf("%05d",residf$FIPS)
residf$CNSSTRACT<- sprintf("%06d",residf$CNSSTRACT)
Residf <- residf%>%
  mutate(GEOID = paste0(GEOIDCN, CNSSTRACT))  %>% filter((LON != 0) & (CNSSTRACT!="0000NA"))%>% select(-c("CNSSTRACT","FIPS","Classification"))

#final merge
library(data.table)
Residf_dt <- as.data.table(Residf)
Red_dt <- as.data.table(Red)
rm(Red, residf, Residf)
finaldf <- merge(Residf_dt, Red_dt, by = c("GEOID", "GEOIDCN"), all.x = TRUE)



finaldf<- as.data.frame(finaldf)
finaldf <- finaldf %>%
  mutate(Metorlevel = replace_na(Metorlevel, "NotMetro"))
# Final modeling table; this is the input read by Yes_ACesimtation_HPC.py and
# Alltype_ACesimtation_HPC_predict.py.
write.csv(finaldf, "./allcombined_for_contemporal_prediction.csv", row.names=F)


```
